data.one_liner: Animated weight picker widget for selecting weight values via swipe or drag.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable widget that lets users pick a weight value with an animated scale. It supports metric and imperial units and allows fine‑grained increments.
use_when: You need a weight input in a fitness or health app
You want a visually engaging picker instead of a simple slider
You need support for both metric and imperial units
You want to customize the appearance of the picker
avoid_when: You only need a basic numeric input
You are building a non‑Flutter platform
You require persistence or state management beyond the widget
strengths: Animated UI for better user experience
Supports both metric and imperial units
weaknesses: Only handles weight selection, not other numeric types
No built‑in state management or persistence
